artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal wires of the ring mechanism appear to fuse and melt into each other at the junction points. The geometry of the wire loops is inconsistent, with some segments disappearing or merging unnaturally rather than maintaining distinct cylindrical volumes.
The interaction between the metal rings and the paper holes lacks crisp definition. The paper edges seem to smear into the metal, lacking the expected sharp shadowing and physical separation.
The depth of field transitions abruptly, and the geometry of the blue cover in the background seems slightly warped, lacking the rigid straight lines expected of a plastic folder.
